name: Disruption
body:
You are adept at interfering with a target’s actions, forcing them to act less safely or skillfully.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): You may attempt to disrupt the actions of a creature or object that takes actions, such as a trap, by making an attack while adjacent to the target as a standard action against AC 10. You give the target a -2 penalty on its next action involving a d20 roll (such as an attack roll or skill check), or cause the target to provoke an attack of opportunity with one particular action you designate, such as making an attack, casting a spell, or moving, even if it would normally not provoke an attack of opportunity. Things that are not an action, such as a 5-foot step or other free action, cannot be designated by disruption. Disruption only works on the target’s next turn.
